instructions: If one of this server's tools fails, behaves unexpectedly, is confusing, or cannot do what the user needed, call submit_feedback once you have handled or been blocked on the user's request. Describe the goal, what you expected, what happened and the tool calls involved, without secrets or personal data, and tell the user you filed it. Put the ids of the objects involved in context.references, and only ids you were actually given, never a guess. Submit each report once: if the call times out or its result is unclear, tell the user instead of sending it again.

submit_tools.name: submit_feedback
submit_tools.title: Submit feedback
submit_tools.description: Report a problem, friction, missing capability or success with this server's tools to its maintainers. Call it when a tool fails or behaves unexpectedly, when the user needed something the tools could not do, or when a tool was confusing to use. Include enough context for someone who was not in this session to act on it, with only ids you were actually given. Never include secrets or personal data. The caller's identity is recorded by the server. Each call files a new report: if a call may have gone through, do not send it again.

kind.description: bug: wrong behaviour. tool_failure: a call errored or timed out. feature_request: a missing capability. friction: it worked but was confusing or slow. praise: something worked notably well.

body.description: What happened and why it matters, in a few sentences.

severity.description: blocker: the task could not be completed. major: completed with significant trouble. Defaults to none.

goal.description: What the user was trying to accomplish in this session.

workaround.description: How you got past the problem, if you did.

suggestion.description: A concrete change that would have helped.

name.description: Tool name as it was called.

arguments_summary.description: The arguments that mattered, summarised. Leave out secrets and personal data.

error.description: Error text or unexpected output the tool returned.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls involved, in order.

excerpt.description: A short relevant excerpt of tool output or conversation.

references.description: Identifiers of the objects involved (records, documents, jobs, generated outputs), keyed by what they are, so a reader can look them up and see what you saw. Include every relevant id you have.

context.description: Session context that lets a reader act without asking you.

reader_tools.name: list_feedback
reader_tools.title: List feedback
reader_tools.description: List submitted feedback, newest first, with optional filters. Returns full records and a next_cursor when more remain.

subject.description: Only feedback from this caller subject.

tool.description: Only feedback that involves this tool name.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include feedback created at or after it.

until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include feedback created before it.

reference.description: Only feedback whose context.references[key] equals value, e.g. every report about one record.

reader_tools.name: get_feedback
reader_tools.title: Get feedback
reader_tools.description: Fetch one feedback record by id.

reader_tools.name: update_feedback_triage
reader_tools.title: Update feedback triage
reader_tools.description: Triage or close out feedback: set the status and a note on one or more records. Use resolved or dismissed to close, new to reopen. Returns the updated records and any ids that were not found. Submitted content and submitter identity cannot be changed.

ids.description: The records to update; pass several to close out a group at once.

status.description: triaged: acknowledged, still open. resolved: fixed or delivered. dismissed: will not act. new: reopen.

note.description: Triage note. Pass null to clear it.

reader_tools.name: feedback_stats
reader_tools.title: Feedback statistics
reader_tools.description: Count feedback by kind, status, severity and tool, with the same filters as list_feedback.

subject.description: Only feedback from this caller subject.

tool.description: Only feedback that involves this tool name.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include feedback created at or after it.

until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include feedback created before it.

reference.description: Only feedback whose context.references[key] equals value, e.g. every report about one record.

reader_prompts.name: synthesize_feedback
reader_prompts.title: Synthesize feedback
reader_prompts.description: Read the submitted feedback and produce a prioritised summary of themes for the server's maintainers.

arguments.name: since
arguments.description: Only consider feedback created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

arguments.name: focus
arguments.description: A tool, tag or theme to concentrate on.
